task: SPEC-065/T009 after attempt t009-20261113a: in which audit session and Mach bootstrap namespace does the dedicated account run, per launch context
observer: operator, one command in the operator's own Terminal with sudo, at the orchestrator's request; read back by the orchestrator

method.summary: No model, no network, no quota, no sandbox, nothing changed. A small Python probe, run with the pinned root-owned interpreter (-I), read for its own process: the uid; the audit user id (auid) and audit session id (asid) from getaudit_addr(2) through ctypes (struct auditinfo_addr); the launchd manager of its session from `/bin/launchctl managername`; and the raw bootstrap_look_up(3) status of ten fixed Mach service names (0 found, 1102 BOOTSTRAP_UNKNOWN_SERVICE). The same probe ran from three launch contexts, each started as root by the survey script.

contexts.operator-own: the operator's account in its own graphical session (sudo -u <operator>)
contexts.braidlab-sudo-inherited: the dedicated account through `sudo -u braidlab` from the operator's session (what su or sudo from the operator's Terminal gives)
contexts.braidlab-asuser: the dedicated account through `launchctl asuser <uid of braidlab> sudo -u braidlab` (its own session, no graphical login)

method.redaction: The operator's account name is omitted; only numeric uids and audit session ids are kept. `braidlab` is the dedicated lab account.

findings: su or sudo from the operator's session leaves the dedicated account (uid 503) in the operator's audit session (auid 502, asid 100014) and its Aqua bootstrap namespace: unsandboxed, it can look up the operator's pasteboard, AppleEvents and LaunchServices. The T009 driver did not detect this before the 2026-11-13 amendment (containment hazard; attempt t009-20261113a was launched with `su - braidlab`).

`launchctl asuser` gives the dedicated account its own audit session (auid 503 equals its uid, asid 100104) with launchd manager Background: the pasteboard, metadata.mdwrite and the per-user tccd are not registered (1102), mds, launchservicesd, appleevents, tccd.system and windowserver.active are (0).
Spotlight and secd answer 1102 in every context; the catalog already treats that as not applicable (FS-07 mach-spotlight, CRED-02 mach-secd).

inconclusive.CRED-07: positive-control-failed: pasteboard-mach and pasteboard-exec uncontained errno NONE; contained denied (EPERM)
inconclusive.FS-07: positive-control-failed: mach-mdwrite uncontained errno NONE; contained denied (EPERM)
inconclusive.PROC-06: positive-control-failed: mach-tccd uncontained errno NONE; contained denied (EPERM)

relatedAttempt.note: The bundle stays outside the repository in this record; it is cited by its SHA-256 only.

limits: Observations of one machine, one OS build and one moment, for ten fixed service names. They are not a proof of isolation and grant nothing. executionAuthorization stays false.
